The reading was also not checked against the repo for things it calls missing. It said a repin command still had to be built, but D154 already provides one. The same reading hazards recur: marking entries prose-only, banned words, and recorded decisions that a change reverses. They are known constraints, but the reading is not shown them.

prevention: Change planning so a critic result with no blocker or major finding is accepted. Pass the minor findings and nits to the producer as required notes, and use any remaining rounds only to repair them. Before the reading is accepted, check each claim that something is missing or must be built against the repo, for example by looking up existing xtask commands. Do not rely on a gate relaxation: every gate has 0 disagreements (verifier 0 of 160, test 0 of 43).
